title: Spinach and Black Bean Cheese Quesadillas
summary: Crisp Mexican-style quesadillas filled with melted cheddar, garlicky spinach and spiced black beans. They make a quick, satisfying vegetarian dinner with plenty of flavour and texture.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the red onion and cook for 3–4 minutes until softened and lightly golden.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika and chilli powder, and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in the black beans, salt and black pepper. Cook for 2–3 minutes, lightly crushing some beans with the back of a spoon so the filling holds together.
Add the spinach in handfuls and cook for 2–3 minutes until wilted and any excess moisture has evaporated. Take the pan off the heat.

Lay out the tortillas. Scatter half the cheddar over one side of each tortilla, spoon over the spinach and black bean filling, then top with the remaining cheddar. Fold each tortilla over to make a half-moon.
Wipe out the pan and return it to medium heat. Cook the quesadillas in batches for 2–3 minutes per side until the tortillas are crisp and golden and the cheese has melted.
Let the quesadillas rest for 1 minute, then cut into wedges. Serve with salsa and lime wedges for squeezing over.
